The Stellaris Empire Manager desktop app, built from `{sha}` on {date}.

**Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.** Unzip it anywhere and run `StellarisEmpireManager.exe`. There is
nothing else to install - the .NET runtime it needs is inside the download.

The first start reads your Stellaris installation, which takes a minute or so, and remembers the
result. After that it opens straight into your empires.

Unlike the website, this one has your designs file: it opens it on launch, and Save writes it back
in place with a dated copy kept beside it.

If the window comes up blank, install the
[Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/), which
the app draws through. Windows 11 already has it, and so does any Windows 10 with a current Edge.

This release is replaced by the next push to main, so this page is always the newest build.
